_note: Advisory-opinion-workflow (adviesaanvraag / advies) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages for the adviesaanvraag register; schema refs BY SLUG (adviesaanvraag / advies), never PascalCase. DEFERRED (design D6, out of this fragment): the two Dashboard stat widgets 'Open adviesaanvragen' (non-terminal lifecycle) and 'Adviezen wachtend op afdoening' (lifecycle advies-uitgebracht) must be added to the Dashboard page in the base src/manifest.json — mergePages replaces a same-id page wholesale, so a fragment cannot add a widget to Dashboard without duplicating the whole page. Both KPIs deep-link to the Adviesaanvragen index pre-filtered to the same set (REQ-AOW-008).

pages.title: Advisory opinions
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/advisory-opinion-workflow/specs/advisory-opinion-workflow/spec.md (REQ-AOW-008 / REQ-AOW-006). Adviesaanvragen index. Columns subject/advisoryBody/requestingBody/sentDate/requestedByDate/lifecycle; quick filters on lifecycle (advisory-body / requesting-body quick filters are documented in the spec but modelled here as the lifecycle dropdown plus the shared sidebar facets, since GovernanceBody references are facet-filtered through the sidebar rather than a static dropdown). The workload view (REQ-AOW-006) is this index filtered to one advisory body via the sidebar facet. Both Dashboard KPI deep-links (DEFERRED base-manifest widgets) target this page pre-filtered.

pages.title: Advisory opinion
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/advisory-opinion-workflow/specs/advisory-opinion-workflow/spec.md (REQ-AOW-008). AdviesaanvraagDetail. Aanvraag data leads 8-wide (question, all dates, verantwoording when set), publication stacked right; the linked requestingBody/advisoryBody/relatedDecision/agendaItem/advisoryStage and the recorded Advies (strekking, samenvatting, document) render as resolved references in the data + Related widgets. Files leaf for submitted documents. Audit trail is a sidebar tab. Out-of-route aanvragen (advisoryStage/relatedDecision empty) render without error, showing no linked decision (REQ-AOW-004).
